info.name: StackHR Backend API
info.description: Postman API collection for StackHR backend modular monolith.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication and user session management endpoints.

request.description: Register a new business account and create organization workspace. Public endpoint.

response.name: Validation Error (400)

request.description: Verify 6-digit email code and generate active session token.
Authenticate business user and set HttpOnly session cookie.
Switch active session organization workspace context (ADR-009). Requires active session and user membership in target organization.

response.name: Not Member (403)

request.description: Public endpoint to preview employee invitation details before setting password.
Public endpoint to set or confirm password and sign in using invitation token.
Resend 6-digit email verification code.
Authenticate platform administrator account.

item.name: Onboarding
item.description: Organization company profile setup and initial employee onboarding endpoints.

request.description: Update organization profile details. Required roles: BUSINESS_OWNER, BUSINESS_ADMIN, HR_ADMIN.

response.name: Validation Error (400)

request.description: Add a single employee during onboarding. Required roles: BUSINESS_OWNER, BUSINESS_ADMIN, HR_ADMIN.
Bulk import employee records from raw CSV payload.
Submit a new approval request. Polymorphic type can be LEAVE, EXPENSE, REIMBURSEMENT, SALARY_ADVANCE, or PAYROLL.
List unified approval inbox requests for current tenant. Non-elevated roles see their own requests.
Approve or reject a pending request. Maker-checker rule: requester cannot approve their own request. Roles: BUSINESS_OWNER, BUSINESS_ADMIN, HR_ADMIN, MANAGER.

response.name: Maker-Checker Violation (403)

item.name: Employees
item.description: Employee CRUD management and offboarding endpoints.

request.description: Create a new employee record under active organization.
Retrieve paginated, filterable employee listing for active organization.
Fetch single employee details including manager and direct reports.
Update specific details of an employee record.
Retrieve nested organization hierarchy tree.
Retrieve summary breakdown of employees grouped by department.
Reassign manager for an employee. Performs circular hierarchy check.
Offboard an employee and mark status as OFFBOARDED.

item.name: Invitations
item.description: Workspace invitation management, member onboarding, and expiration handling endpoints.

request.description: Send a 7-day expiration workspace invitation to a new team member.
List all workspace invitations for active organization.
Public endpoint to inspect invitation validity and expiration status.
Public endpoint to accept workspace invitation and create user account.
Revoke a pending workspace invitation.
Resend invitation and refresh 7-day expiration date.

item.name: Onboarding Templates & Checklists
item.description: Department onboarding template management and per-employee checklist tracking endpoints.

request.description: List department-based onboarding templates for active organization.
Save or update a department onboarding template.
Get onboarding checklist tasks assigned to a specific employee.
Toggle completed status for an employee onboarding checklist task.

item.name: Leave Management
item.description: Leave policies, leave type configurations, leave balances, and request submission routed to generic Approvals Engine.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Annual Paid Leave",
  "description": "Standard annual paid time off",
  "daysPerYear": 20,
  "paid": true,
  "requiresApproval": true
}

request.description: Create a new leave type and allocate initial balances to active employees.
List all leave types for active organization.
Retrieve current leave balances (allocated, used, pending, remaining) for logged in employee or organization.
Submit a leave request. Validates leave balance and routes through the generic Approvals Engine (ADR-003).

response.name: Success

request.description: Retrieve paginated leave request history with optional status and employee filters.
Retrieve details of a single leave request.
